RANDOLPH PLANNING STUDY BOARD ADDITIONAL GOALS AND OBJECTIVES
b. Rehabilitation Objectives
(1) Physical Goals: 
(a) To restore deteriorated structures before dilapidation, and encourage voluntary participation in rehabilitation and maintenance programs through financial assistance and professional guidance for property owners within designated conservation areas in the Randolph Urban Renewal Area.
(b) To provide recreational and open-space areas throughout the community, and insure that a total environmental approach is implemented to provide landscaped, lighted, and physically pleasing and safe areas.
(c) Rehabilitation of some existing multi-family buildings for elderly housing that include appropriate facilities for their needs and maintain the architectural integrity of the neighborhood of which it is a part.
(d) Improve public and semi-public areas within the community.
(e) Provide maximum off-street parking opportunities through widened and generally improved alley systems providing access to rear yards.
(f) To provide transportation in addition to public bus lines, on an intercommunity basis.
(g) To make maximum use of all HUD-FHA subsidy housing programs to obtain financial assistance in making these objectives a reality for all income levels.
(2) Social Goals:
(a) Encourage tenant-residents to become owner-residents through utilization of government subsidized housing programs in combination with rehabilitation efforts.
(b) To encourage the present community members to remain in Randolph prior to, during, and in completion of the program.
